title: Zingy Creamy Zanzibari Durian Pancakes
description: A creamy and zesty Malaysian dish featuring durian blended into a pancake batter with blueberries, packed with umami flavors suitable for midnight cravings. Perfect as a dessert or snack.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Blend durian flesh with blueberries, vanilla extract, eggs, flour, sugar, and salt in a blender until smooth.
Slowly add milk while blending to form a batter. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
Pour batter into the heated skillet, forming one pancake per ladleful.
Cook each side of the pancakes for about 1-2 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve hot with a dollop of whipped cream and a handful of fresh blueberries on top.
